sub_indicators.label: ICT exports and production
sub_indicators.subject: tech.industry
sub_indicators.text: National capacity in DT-related production: ICT exports and production
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Digital Transformation Strategy's digital industry pillar asks for ICT assembling and manufacturing plants and growing ICT exports; STISA-2034 asks for technology-based production.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2023 or later, puts ICT service exports below 0.05 per cent of GDP.
ICT service exports are 0.05 per cent of GDP or more in the latest figure, for 2023 or later, from the World Bank's series.
ICT service exports are 0.2 per cent of GDP or more.
ICT service exports are 0.5 per cent of GDP or more.
ICT service exports are 0.5 per cent of GDP or more, and a plant assembling or making phones, computers or other ICT equipment is in production in the country.
